_doc: FireRed/LeafGreen Route 2 grass: Pidgey 45%, Rattata 45%, Caterpie 5%, Weedle 5%. mode 'both' so they roam the route visibly as well as ambushing from tall grass. Caterpie/Weedle are the bug half of the route; the rest of FRLG Route 2's table is the Mr. Mime trade, which we have no trading for. B46: rate 21 = FRLG land_mons.encounter_rate (pret src/data/wild_encounters.json sRoute2_FireRed); Route 2 North shares this table.
